name: Hire the Future
what_you_do: Free job help for young people. You can get help searching for jobs, getting ready for interviews and planning a career at an IDES office.
pay_detail: This is job search help, not a job. Pay is not stated.
deadline_text: No deadline. Visit an IDES office any time.
how_to_apply: Make a free account on IllinoisJobLink.com to search for jobs. For job readiness help, use the IDES Office Locator to find the nearest office.
notes: The page also links to free tools to help you pick a career. It links to pages about staying safe at your first job, too.
